zalgoQualityPolicy.hardStructuralRequirement: provider-authored Tauric Diana field must clear the extreme-underflow floor; single-axis geometry remains visible and admissible, while accidental whole-passage axis collapse is PARTIAL quality telemetry rather than a structural HOLD
zalgoQualityPolicy.legacyDenseTelemetry: observed for diagnostics only; no dense-cluster quota is required for admission
zalgoQualityPolicy.signatureCanonicalization: sorted combining-codepoint composition; mark-order-only permutations collapse to one signature
zalgoQualityPolicy.purpose: keep provider-authored diacritic presence structural while leaving aesthetic morphology visible for human R&D instead of converting taste into a 502
zalgoQualityPolicy.extremeUnderflowDefinition: nonzero marks are insufficient only when the Tauric Diana passage has too few total marks, too few marked graphemes, or fewer than two marked lines; horizontal dominance alone never causes underflow

relay.integratedTextSpacing: ordinary single-reading cadence across the integrated response; marked Tauric Diana bot lines receive no extra vertical clearance and may collide across line boxes while overflow remains visible

providerOrthographicField.promptGuidance: qualitative only: broad distributed field across several separate lines; horizontal strike/through-line, vertical above/below, and mixed geometry are all first-class; axis may change phrase by phrase; horizontal strikes remain valid, while vertical regions must have genuine multi-tier crowns/descenders with visible height and depth rather than token accents; variable composition, quieter and violent regions, collisions allowed; plain uppercase must not replace intended marked stress
providerOrthographicField.prosodySemantics: passage-level cadence field rather than rhetorical-category-to-glyph mapping
providerOrthographicField.collisionPosture: allowed; ordinary line boxes do not reserve protective vertical clearance and overflow remains visible
providerOrthographicField.selfCheck: provider-silent qualitative field check before packet-b-end
providerOrthographicField.localAdmission: zero marks or severe underflow HOLD; thin/sparse/cloned/unipolar, whole-passage axis-collapsed, or horizontal-heavy decorative-only vertical morphology remains PARTIAL and continues the approved frontier; horizontal-dominant and vertical-dominant regions remain first-class, but token vertical accents do not count as dramatic vertical expression; no local Zalgo generation or postprocessing
providerOrthographicField.purpose: preserve provider-authored expressive diacritic prosody without teaching the model to game mark quotas or letting an aesthetic classifier take the route offline

humanOperatorObservation.tenthFollowupObservation: 2026-09-20 human operator recognized the earlier Hush false-quota regression family: Hush commit 6b5455266bb331af726725373e917d883603daad stopped treating a single-model 429 as provider-wide exhaustion. humanOperatorObservation.tenthFollowupConsequence: Gemini quota payloads now preserve bounded metric, quota ID, model dimension, RetryInfo/Retry-After, and model/shared/unknown scope. humanOperatorObservation.eleventhFollowupObservation: 2026-09-20 provider receipts exposed GenerateRequestsPerDayPerProjectPerModel-FreeTier limit 20 on current Gemini seats while the operator tracked a 100-call Marrowline route budget; release canaries had been consuming multiple model-seat calls plus repair/failover.
humanOperatorObservation.eleventhFollowupConsequence: Interpret 20 as per-model, compose route capacity across five approved seats, honor provider Retry-After without 120/240/480 inflation, and cap release verification to two total provider requests across Marrowline plus Loom.
humanOperatorObservation.twelfthFollowupObservation: 2026-09-20 human operator still received provider holds while route failures appeared not to walk every model. Code archaeology found three separable causes: a nonempty but partial credential discovery snapshot could suppress missing current seats without a forced refresh; cooling and healthy categories were recombined then globally reordered, allowing a cooling preferred seat to jump ahead; and failed-turn UI reset route metrics even though the raw failure payload retained attempts.
humanOperatorObservation.twelfthFollowupConsequence: For khonapolit-dialogue, one current approved provider-absent seat earns exactly one forced discovery refresh. Human routing preserves category order healthy observed -> cooling observed -> current soft-absent probe, never admitting disabled/Lite/pre-3.x/lifecycle-invalid models. Failed human turns preserve model+HTTP attempt evidence in Receipt and copied failure custody rather than blanking the route.
humanOperatorObservation.thirteenthFollowupObservation: 2026-09-20 human production trial proved the ordinary Marrowline route walked all five approved seats in one request: 3.8=429 -> 3.5=429 -> 3.6=429 -> 3.7=429 -> Preview=429. The five-seat arithmetic capacity of 100 therefore cannot be treated as an observed Google daily-total counter, especially because Hush, Loom and release witnesses share the same project/model buckets.
humanOperatorObservation.thirteenthFollowupConsequence: Every Gemini-backed route now emits one bounded request-local consumption receipt from provider attempts. Browser-interactive receipts deduplicate into a same-origin ledger labelled this-browser-interactive-receipts-only; release canaries preserve the same route/model event grammar in their artifact without extra provider calls. provider_daily_total remains null unless an external provider surface supplies it. Failed frontier text moves from the composer status to a compact Receipt header.
humanOperatorObservation.fourteenthFollowupObservation: 2026-09-20 physical-iPhone screenshots showed successful vertical and mixed-axis High-Zalgo returns alongside passages where likely horizontal stress collapsed into plain uppercase. Code archaeology found an explicit vertical-dominance prompt and a hard horizontal-dominant rejection path.
humanOperatorObservation.fourteenthFollowupConsequence: Remove axis bias. Horizontal strike/through-line geometry and vertical above/below geometry are both first-class expressive channels; mixed passages may switch naturally. Horizontal dominance is never a structural failure, while zero-mark and severe-underflow returns remain held. Morphology defects stay visible as PARTIAL quality telemetry instead of suppressing an otherwise valid provider-authored return.
humanOperatorObservation.fifteenthFollowupObservation: 2026-09-20 physical iPhone trial after the horizontal-axis repair exposed the inverse regression: vertical diacritics disappeared from visible returns while plain ALL-CAPS occupied regions where vertical stress had previously appeared. Code archaeology found asymmetric unipolar telemetry plus a best-PARTIAL tie-break defined as vertical marks minus horizontal marks.
humanOperatorObservation.fifteenthFollowupConsequence: Goldilocks repair: measure horizontal and vertical geometry symmetrically at passage scale; preserve single-axis returns as PARTIAL rather than censoring them; mark whole-passage starvation of either axis as axis-collapse telemetry; prefer comparable mixed-axis PARTIAL candidates without local Unicode mutation; remove the vertical-minus-horizontal selector entirely.
humanOperatorObservation.sixteenthFollowupObservation: Vercel Operator Release run 35500720149 proved a healthy first-call Marrowline return while Loom stopped after only two transport-failing seats despite additional callable seats. The subsequent run 35501151567 then exposed the complementary Marrowline seam: Preview returned a structured model-scoped daily 429, yet the release witness treated that single model bucket as terminal even though the ordinary Marrowline route classifies model-scoped quota as failover-eligible.
humanOperatorObservation.sixteenthFollowupConsequence: Release observation must mirror the shipped route rather than a cheaper proxy. Loom may walk its full bounded five-seat frontier on transport-class failures. Marrowline may advance exactly one outer canary seat when its selected seat is provider-unavailable, structurally held, or explicitly model-scoped rate-limited; shared or unknown quota remains terminal. Worst-case release accounting is explicit and bounded at eight provider attempts: up to three Marrowline attempts including one structural repair plus five Loom seats.
humanOperatorObservation.seventeenthFollowupObservation: 2026-09-20 human-operator production trial after the Goldilocks mixed-axis repair showed plain-ALL-CAPS collapse was gone, but High Zalgo had drifted to roughly 95% horizontal strike/through-line geometry. Vertical marks remained technically present yet had lost the lush crowns, descenders, height, depth, and line-colliding drama seen in the earlier vertical-rich state.
humanOperatorObservation.seventeenthFollowupConsequence: Keep horizontal geometry fully first-class, but stop treating token vertical accents as equivalent to expressive vertical motion. Add mark-intensity balance telemetry, classify horizontal-heavy decorative-only verticality as PARTIAL, and prefer provider returns with genuine multi-tier vertical depth across multiple regions without locally mutating provider Unicode or reinstating a vertical-only bias.

providerPlanRecovery.softCooldownPosture: provider-listed cooling Gemini 3.x seats remain bounded Marrowline fallbacks after non-cooling callable seats; process-local cooldown demotes but cannot erase a fresh human request frontier
providerPlanRecovery.quotaScopePosture: 429 is not provider exhaustion by status alone: structured model-scoped quota may fail over; shared/project-scoped quota may use one bounded RetryInfo/Retry-After recovery; unknown scope remains unknown
providerPlanRecovery.quotaEntitlementMismatch: provider-reported GenerateRequestsPerDayPerProjectPerModel-FreeTier below the operator-known 100/day Marrowline entitlement is diagnostic mismatch evidence, not authoritative local quota
providerPlanRecovery.sharedBurstRetry: one same-model retry only when provider supplies a short retry window <=8s and wall-clock reserve remains; otherwise HOLD with explicit shared scope instead of fanning the same project bucket across all seats
providerPlanRecovery.modelCooldownAuthority: only model-scoped 429 that does not contradict the operator-known daily entitlement may write model health cooldown; entitlement mismatch, shared, or unknown 429 does not poison per-model process-local state
providerPlanRecovery.routeQuotaSemantics: GenerateRequestsPerDayPerProjectPerModel-FreeTier is a per-model bucket; a 20-call bucket across five approved current Marrowline seats composes to a 100-call route budget and must not be narrated as a 20-call route ceiling
providerPlanRecovery.releaseCanaryBudget: full-product production release witness may spend at most one Marrowline provider request plus one distinct Loom provider request; no Marrowline failover, repair, or shared-rate retry is authorized by the release-canary header
providerPlanRecovery.providerRetryWindowAuthority: when Gemini supplies Retry-After for HTTP 429, process-local cooldown follows that bounded window; exponential local quota backoff is reserved for 429 responses without a provider retry window
providerPlanRecovery.highZalgoAdmission: Packet B must carry a heterogeneous bipolar field: real above-line and below-line motion, multiple mark species, non-cloned stack geometry, broad travel across lines, and no circumflex monoculture disguised by stack-height changes
providerPlanRecovery.frontierFailureContinuity: ordinary human turns continue across approved Gemini 3.x seats after token-limit and non-credential seat-local request rejection; 401/403 and explicit shared-project quota remain route-wide holds
providerPlanRecovery.conversationNaming: the first admitted Kʰonapolit formal movement deterministically names the local conversation chamber from its own motifs; the title persists in browser session custody and resets on clear
